title: Chapter 825
text:
At the same time that the Atimo fleet was destroyed, Han Xiao, who was slacking at the border of the Garu Star Cluster, received the intelligence sent back by Philip. The information about the planets that the Great Cosmos Corps had accumulated was also sent back.

"Let me see how much I've gained …" Han Xiao opened the information and browsed through it.

Although the Great Cosmos Corps was just a castle in the sky, they had discovered quite a number of planets over the years, scattered across a few Star Systems in the middle of the Garu Star Cluster.

Some of the planets originally had native civilizations, but they were all enslaved by the Great Cosmos Corps. Their internal information was not like the information that the Red Empire had in his previous life. This information recorded the process of the Great Cosmos Corps' plundering in detail, including video footage, which was filled with bloodshed.

Shaking his head, Han Xiao contacted Chief Commander Tarrokov.

"I've obtained the information about the Great Cosmos Corps. I've sent you a copy."

"Good job." Tarrokov was overjoyed. He quickly browsed through it and smiled. "The dynasty will remember your contribution."

Before Han Xiao could say anything, a notification appeared on the interface.

You have submitted [Great Cosmos Corps Exploration Information]!

+ 1,500 Red Empire Contribution Points.

+ 550 Personal Exploration Points.

[Flickering World — First Round] Evaluation increased by one grade.

The Flickering World Main Storyline Mission was a faction mission, and exploring Garu was the first round. All the players shared the mission evaluation, and the mission evaluation depended on everyone's total Exploration Points.

This was a special exploration achievement. After more than a month of exploration, everyone's mission evaluation was originally D-, but now, everyone's evaluation had been raised to D.

It did not seem like much, but this was a Grade S + Main Storyline Mission. Every small increase in evaluation would take a long time, and it would only get more difficult toward the end.

However, the 1,500 Red Empire Contribution Points was the reward that made Han Xiao excited. He had spent 6,000 Contribution Points to exchange for the Ultimate Knowledge [Mechanical Life Tinder], and he still had 2,000 + Contribution Points left.

Now that he had obtained 1,500 Contribution Points in one go, he only needed to obtain another 2,000 Contribution Points to exchange for a new Ultimate Knowledge. Due to his status, the cost of exchanging for Ultimate Knowledge was discounted by half. In his previous life, an ordinary player would have needed 12,000 Contribution Points to exchange for a new Ultimate Knowledge.

However, when normal players joined the Red Empire, they would be able to obtain military ranks. As they continued to do missions to increase their ranks, they would be able to enjoy more and more discounts. However, even if they were promoted to the highest rank, they would not be able to reach the 50% discount that he had.

The hidden mission brought by Maple Moon made him a little fatter. Han Xiaoxin was very happy.

Not only did such a capable player need to be rewarded, he also needed to be rewarded handsomely. It was a good opportunity to motivate other players to explore the hidden quest.

No one would be rich without a windfall. That was why it was said that being a jungler was still very lucrative.

While he was looking at the interface, Tarrokov did not stop and said, "This intelligence can save us a lot of manpower. I will get someone to record this information into the star map. Since you have already sent people to destroy the Great Cosmos Corps, you will temporarily take over their territory. Since you have chosen to spread out, leave a team to develop in the center of the Garu Star Cluster."

"Sure." Han Xiao smiled. This was the reason why he had come along.

Compared to the planets at the edge of the Star Cluster, the center of the Star Cluster would be the most prosperous region in the future. In order to destroy the Great Cosmos Corps, the expedition team had officially established a long-distance channel. When the time came, he would be able to directly head to the center of the Star Cluster and occupy all the most famous planets in his previous life.

If he occupied the territory first, the other dynasty allies would not be able to snatch it from him and would have to take a detour. As long as he occupied the most prosperous regions in the Star Cluster, he would be able to earn the most.

Furthermore, with the first long-distance channel as a foundation, he would not attract any suspicion when he went to the east of the Star Cluster to steal Universal Treasures in the future.

Tarrokov then said that he would report this to the dynasty and ask them to reward the Black Star Corps with additional resources.

The two of them chatted for a while before hanging up.

Han Xiao then connected to Philip's vision. Only then did he have the time to look at the battlefield many Star Systems away to see how the players were fighting with Atimo.

…

Boom! Boom!

Explosions occurred one after another!

Wave after wave of people surged forward and charged towards Atimo along the walls of the Ring-shaped Mountain like a tidal wave.

Atimo fought alone and weaved through the crowd to avoid the attacks. Countless energy beams shot out from various parts of his body like a mobile cannon, shooting toward the crowd in all directions.

Beams of light swept across the crowded battlefield, striking different locations and causing violent explosions, sending the shielded figures flying.

The battle had already lasted for quite some time, and countless players were using their abilities. All sorts of lights flashed on the battlefield, and all sorts of abilities appeared one after another. The number of debuffs on Atimo had never dropped below thirty. Although the duration was short, there were too many players, and the debuffs were constantly refreshed.

The difference in level was too great, and Atimo had the advantage in speed. He constantly changed his position, and the players were unable to lock onto him or hold his aggro. It was as though the players in different regions were randomly attacked by Atimo. As long as they encountered him, the players who had just reached Grade B would not be able to tank his damage.

Normally, the players would fight a dungeon boss in a dungeon with a few or a few dozen people. This was the first time that hundreds of thousands of players were fighting against a real character of such a high level. Every single team wanted to do as much damage as possible, and they did not care about friendly fire.

The difficulty of this battle was much higher than what the players had expected. All the strategies that they had thought of before the battle were basically useless, and they could only improvise.

However, what the players did not know was that the pressure that Atimo was facing was countless times greater than theirs.

He shuttled through the crowd. Originally, he wanted to use the crowd as a meat shield to make this group of enemies hesitate and worry about accidentally injuring them. But he was shocked to find that this group of people did not care about the life or death of their comrades. They were willing to blow up their comrades to attack him.

Even Atimo, who had a cold personality, was shocked by the players. He clearly had no way to escape, and the enemy had the upper hand, but they still chose to attack without any regard for their own lives!

This is too cold-blooded! The Black Star Corps is actually so unscrupulous!

The players were not afraid of death, and his strategy was completely useless. Atimo could only endure a sea of attacks at every moment, and he had no choice but to expend energy to maintain his shield.

The attacks of the players were only at Grade B, but he did not dare take so much damage with his body. After all, he did not have a strong physique.

His shield was not able to block out all the damage, especially the Psychic attacks. Most of the negative statuses that he had received were from the Psychics.

Atimo also had quite a few light injuries on his body, and his health was slowly decreasing. He did not have a high recovery ability, and even if he used his energy to stimulate his cells, his regeneration speed would not be able to keep up with his health.

Furthermore, with his energy being depleted so quickly, he felt that his chances of killing all the enemies were getting slimmer and slimmer.

Although that was what he thought in his heart, as long as there was even the slightest chance of survival, Atimo did not want to wait for death.

Even if I can't escape, I have to deal a huge amount of damage to your Supers! Atimo swore in his heart.

Even if he was going to die, he had to bite off a piece of meat from the Black Star Corps. Since they were fighting so crazily, he would be able to deal as much damage as possible to them.

Atimo's figure flashed and moved to another area. Suddenly, a series of mechanical traps appeared under his feet, and a strong magnetic field grabbed onto his body, creating an extremely strong restraining force that slowed down his movements.

"Come over, I've caught him!" One of the players was overjoyed.

Tu tu tu tu! The turrets surrounded by the Mechanical Force of different players all turned around and fired at Atimo. A dense rain of bullets was fired at him.

Atimo let out a low roar, and the energy shield solidified once again. The rain of bullets hit the shield, creating sparks and sparks.

Rumble! Energy shot out from his tentacles and fingers like a peacock spreading its tail, instantly destroying the turrets that were attacking him.

Following which, he stomped his feet and released an energy shockwave, shattering the mechanical traps that were grabbing onto him and regaining his freedom. Just as Atimo was about to retreat, he suddenly felt dizzy. More than ten Psychics rushed over and threw mental shockwaves at him.

During that short moment of delay, a large group of Pugilists charged forward, and their fists smashed onto the shield like cannonballs.

Bang bang bang!

The shield started to flicker, and Atimo gritted his teeth. Many of his tentacles swept out like whips, and along with the trajectory of the attack, a powerful shockwave blasted away the Pugilists who were entangling him, smashing into a large group of people.

Fighting on the ground was very disadvantageous for him, and Atimo tried to fly again. However, he felt an immense pressure when he was only ten meters above the ground, and his movements became extremely slow.

Looking up, there were countless magic arrays floating in the sky, stacked with countless anti-gravity spells.

Even if the spells of a Grade B Mage were stacked together, they would not be able to trap a Calamity Grade Super. However, it would take Atimo a lot of time to pass through the anti-gravity zone, and he did not dare do so as he would easily become a target.

Furthermore, even if he could fly, if he did not kill all these pursuers, they would still chase after him with their spaceships. He did not feel that his flying speed was faster than a spaceship, so where could he escape to on this planet?

Both parties fought a bloody battle, and after who knew how long, Atimo was completely exhausted.

He could not remember how many enemies he had killed, probably in the tens of thousands. Furthermore, the enemies had probably injured many times more people than he had killed.

"A bunch of lunatics!" Atimo spat out a mouthful of blood and dragged his heavy body to continue fighting.

His energy was almost depleted, and the injuries all over his body were getting worse and worse.

"Looks like I don't have a chance …" Atimo's heart sank, and he became even more ferocious.

At the very least, the enemies had suffered heavy casualties. Even if he died, he would drag a bunch of people down with him!

However, right at this moment, Atimo dodged another round of attacks. Looking at the densely packed crowd around him, he suddenly realized something that he had neglected while immersed in the battle.

After fighting for so long, he should have killed a lot of enemies. The enemies clearly did not send any reinforcements, so why did the number of enemies not seem to have changed?

Atimo was stunned.

In his world view, if a person died, they would definitely die. He did not have the concept of resurrection, so he did not pay attention to the situation. However, the battlefield was so chaotic, and there were more than three hundred thousand enemies. He did not have the time to distinguish who he was facing at all. Furthermore, he was in a very dangerous situation, so he could not divert his attention and only noticed this strange situation now.

After noticing this situation, Atimo carefully observed for a while, and his expression suddenly changed.

"These people … are actually undying?"

Atimo's eyes widened in disbelief. A deep sense of despair passed through his body like a bolt of lightning, and a deep sense of helplessness appeared in his heart.

No wonder … no wonder they did not care about the casualties. It turned out that these people did not have the concept of 'casualties' at all …

He thought that he had caused a lot of damage to the enemies, but it turned out that it was just his own wishful thinking. His resistance … was just a futile struggle …

If it was just that there were too many enemies, Atimo would still have the desire to fight to the death. However, when he realized that the enemies could actually resurrect, Atimo's mentality collapsed, and his will to fight disappeared.

"AHHHH!" Atimo no longer had any hope of surviving. He roared toward the sky and unleashed all of the remaining energy in his body without holding back.

Rumble!

Over a dozen thick pillars of light swept across the battlefield, instantly killing anyone who came into contact with them. In the blink of an eye, the pillars of light cleared out a large area of the battlefield. Just this one attack had killed over 10,000 players.

"Attention! All of you, get down! This should be the final stage of the boss, and it's about to enter the killing zone! "

The players hurriedly turned into Voldemort, and the pillars of light swept past their heads. Just the shockwaves from the pillars of light were enough to deal a certain amount of damage to them.

The more than ten pillars of light quickly dissipated, and Atimo finally squeezed himself dry. He wobbled as if he would fall to the ground at any moment.

Bang!

The next moment, an artillery shell blasted Atimo to the ground. When the players saw that, they hurriedly got up and swarmed toward Atimo, fighting for an advantageous position and attacking Atimo.

Atimo, who had lost all ability to fight back, was like a doll being fought over by a group of people. His limbs were quickly torn off, and he allowed the players to torture his body. His eyes became more and more lifeless, and the faces of the players around him were like that of a demon in his eyes.

When Atimo was on the verge of death, he suddenly hallucinated. The faces of the players around him changed, and it was as if they had all turned into his face.

He was in a daze, and his plundering life for so many years appeared in his mind.

Could this be retribution?

Puchi!

The next moment, his vision spun, and his head was pulled off by someone. The life in Atimo's eyes quickly disappeared, and only a grayish-white color was left. He had lost all signs of life.

"Hahaha! The reward for killing him is ours! "

The players from Dynasty cheered.

Second Prince was overjoyed. In his excitement, he kicked Atimo's head away like a ball, and King Admiral shook his head helplessly.

"Tsk, it's actually Dynasty."

"I died three times, and I didn't even get to touch anything. What a loss."

"Why don't we get rid of them here?"

The pro players from the other guilds glared at Dynasty.

Vodka and Captain Old Henry were a little disappointed. The reward for killing the Boss had actually been taken away by the previous champion club. It would have been fine even if it was given to some other small club. Dynasty would probably be a strong opponent in this season's Pro League.

During the chaotic battle earlier, they had aimed their attacks at the Chinese teams, wanting to pretend that they had accidentally injured their teammates. However, they realized that they had also suffered a lot of accidental injuries, dying about three times on average. They guessed that they had also been targeted by the Chinese guilds.

Although the ordinary players did not receive the reward, they were still very excited.

Atimo was the first true Calamity Grade Boss to die by their hands!

This was the first time the players had killed a Calamity Grade Super!

On the other side, Han Xiao also received Philip's report and heaved a sigh of relief.

"We've finally killed a Calamity Grade Super …"

If it was a Calamity Grade Super like Ashes, the players would not be able to kill him even if they used up all their revivals.

However, Atimo did not have such a perverted ability. He was only an ordinary Calamity Grade Super. Philip had caused his spaceship to crash, and the players had spaceships to chase after him. Thus, he had no way to escape and could only face the players head-on. Furthermore, the players already had Grade B combat strength, so Atimo could only die in the end.

In Han Xiao's eyes, this matter was a milestone for the players, and it was also a turning point for the players.

In his previous life, the players had only killed their first Calamity Grade Super in Version 4.0. After that, the players all knew that they had the strength to threaten ordinary Calamity Grades. Their mentality changed, and they became more confident … as well as more suicidal.

This was something that could not be avoided. The players were too subjective, and they would have such thoughts sooner or later. However, the effect on Han Xiao was very limited at the moment. His strength and influence were enough to suppress the little demons in the hearts of most players.

He had purposely gotten the players to deal with Atimo so that they could kill a Calamity Grade Super as members of the Black Star Corps. If not for Philip's help, they would not have been able to stop Atimo from escaping, and they would not have been able to kill the first Calamity Grade Super.

Thus, this first kill was the result of both the players and the faction. As long as the players understood this point, it would increase their sense of belonging to the faction.

Furthermore, this first kill was a milestone and the first collective action of the army. Through the collective memory of this achievement, it might strengthen the bond that many people had with the army.
